start: Workout tab, a routine's preview, routine with 4 exercises

steps.action: Tap 'Edit routine'
user_sees: Screen 'Edit routine', subtitle like 'Push · My plan'
Name box with the routine's name, DAY TYPE chips, each exercise with Sets, Rep min, Rep max, Warm-up sets, rest and 'Note (optional)'
must_not: Steppers shown when Settings > Rep range is not 'Match my goal' (the range shows instead)

steps.action: Change the name to 'Push A' and tap 'Add exercise'
user_sees: 'Add exercise' list
must_not: The typed name lost when coming back

steps.action: Tap an exercise
user_sees: Back on 'Edit routine' with the new exercise at the end and the name 'Push A' kept
must_not: The exercise added twice after a quick double tap
The editor popped off as well

steps.action: Raise Sets by one, tap 'Move up' on the last exercise, tap 'Start routine'
user_sees: The live workout opens with the changed sets and order
must_not: Two quick changes undoing each other
The old name on the live workout

steps.action: Tap 'More for this routine', then 'Duplicate routine'
user_sees: Sheet 'Where should the copy go?' with 'My routines' first
must_not: The copy put in the routine's own folder without asking

steps.action: Pick a folder
user_sees: The copy opens in the editor
must_not: The rename typed just before lost on the copy

steps.action: Open the menu again and tap 'Move to folder', pick another folder
user_sees: The subtitle names the new folder
must_not: The routine shown in both folders

start: Edit routine screen, a library exercise in the routine

steps.action: Tap 'Swap <exercise>'
user_sees: A list of other exercises that fit the routine's equipment and sore areas
must_not: An exercise already in the routine offered
Swap shown for the member's own exercise

steps.action: Pick one
user_sees: The editor shows the new exercise in the same place
must_not: The old exercise kept as well
'Could not swap' when it worked

steps.action: Type a name that is not in the list and tap 'Create'
user_sees: The 'New exercise' form with the typed name
must_not: Two forms opened by a double tap

steps.action: Save the new exercise
user_sees: It is added to the routine
must_not: It added to a different routine

steps.action: Tap 'More for this routine', then 'Share routine'
user_sees: A share sheet for the routine
must_not: The menu and the share sheet both stuck open

steps.action: Clear the name and leave the box
user_sees: The name becomes 'Routine'
must_not: A routine saved with an empty name

steps.action: Raise Sets from 12 to 13
user_sees: '13 sets?' 'That is more sets than most routines use.' with 'Keep 13 sets'
must_not: A hard cap that refuses 13
The question asked again at 14

steps.action: Remove every exercise ('Remove exercise?' then 'Remove')
user_sees: 'No exercises yet' 'Add exercises to build this routine.'
'Start routine' greyed out
must_not: A workout started with no exercises

steps.action: Tap 'Move to folder' when there is only one folder
user_sees: 'No other folder' 'Make a folder on the Workout tab first.'
must_not: An empty folder list

steps.action: Change a set count with the save failing
user_sees: 'Couldn't save your last change. It is still shown here.' and 'Try again'
must_not: The change dropped silently
A success look on a failed save

steps.action: Tap 'More for this routine', 'Delete routine'
user_sees: 'Delete routine?' 'This removes the routine and its exercise list. History is unaffected.'
must_not: Deleted without asking

steps.action: Tap 'Delete'
user_sees: Back to the screen before; the routine is gone from its folder
must_not: Past workouts of this routine deleted
The routine still listed

steps.action: Open the old routine link again
user_sees: 'Routine not found' 'This routine may have been deleted.'
must_not: 'Couldn't load this routine' for a routine that is really gone

start: Edit routine, two exercises next to each other

steps.action: Turn on superset with the next exercise, then turn it off again
user_sees: The pair marked as a superset, then back to two plain exercises
must_not: A third exercise pulled into the group
The superset left on after turning it off

start: Member's free month has ended (no Plus)

steps.action: Open a routine and tap 'Edit routine', change sets and save
user_sees: The editor works in full and the change is kept
must_not: A paywall or lock on editing routines
A routine deleted because the plan ended
